what_differs: WAGR-45 (Ready, Must Have) removes all Deal access and hides partner everywhere for reps. Later client decisions keep the partner code in the global deal name shown to reps (2026-08-11) and add the partner short code to the Sign-Up header for reps (2026-09-23); the 2026-08-11 demo hides partner on the deal page rather than removing deal access, and the 2026-09-25 test shows a rep view of the deal's affiliate links. WAGR-94 also assumes reps keep read-only Deal access.
suggested_action: Re-scope WAGR-45 to: partner field hidden from rep layouts, partner code allowed in Deal Name and Sign-Up header, and a decision on whether reps keep read-only Deal access (align with WAGR-94). Then move it to the right status.
